title: Minimum Operations to Convert Number
goal: Reach goal using additions, subtractions, and XOR with the fewest operations.
strategy: BFS explores reachable values between zero and one thousand. A generated goal counts immediately even outside that interval, but an out-of-range value cannot become an intermediate state.
